title: Cap. V Obj. 4 Sol close: they deduce from foresight denied secundum quid, not simply excluded
pass_a_gloss: They therefore try to deceive us by arguments of this kind, while those absurdities which are rightly deduced from foresight of faith excluded or simply denied, they deduce from foresight of faith denied in a certain respect, that is, as an antecedent condition unto predestination itself.
pass_b_english: So they try to deceive us with such arguments: absurdities that follow only if foresight of faith is excluded or simply denied, they deduce from foresight denied secundum quid — that is, denied as an antecedent condition of predestination itself.
source_text: Fallere igitur nos conantur hujusmodi argumentationibus, dum illa absurda quae recte deducantur ab exclusa aut simpliciter negata praevisione fidei, illi deducunt a negata praevisione fidei secundum quid, hoc est, ut antecedanea conditione ad ipsam praedestinationem.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. V Obj. 4 section 417. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap5_obj4_densify. Honest partial.
